::: {#sol-toppings}

There are $15$ choices.

Each choice is a set of one or two toppings,
so count the choices of two different toppings and the choices of one topping separately.

- **Two different toppings.**
  There are $5$ choices for the first topping and $4$ for the second,
  so there are $5 \cdot 4 = 20$ [ordered pairs](#def-ordered-pair) of different toppings.
  The sets $\set{\text{sprinkles}, \text{fudge}}$ and $\set{\text{fudge}, \text{sprinkles}}$ are equal,
  so each choice comes from exactly two ordered pairs.
  That leaves $20 / 2 = 10$ choices.
- **The same topping twice.**
  The choice is a set with one element,
  such as $\set{\text{nuts}}$,
  and there are $5$ of these.

In all, there are $10 + 5 = 15$ choices.

:::
